description:
Record the cryptographic inventory (CBOM) of one system for post-quantum migration. Every change creates
a new version and is written to the agency's tamper-evident 'pqc-inventory' log. Scanners and agents can
submit results directly. Requires the organization API key.

actor.description: Who made the change (person, scanner or agent)
actor.title: Actor

system.description: System record: system_id, name, bureau, owner, high_value_asset, high_impact, sensitive_until_year, fedramp_cloud, notes, assets [{asset_id, kind (key_establishment|signature|encryption|symmetric|hash|protocol|certificate), algorithm, key_size, protocol, location, product, vendor, status (not_started|planned|in_progress|hybrid|migrated), target_date (YYYY-MM-DD), replacement, evidence}]. Replaces the system's previous inventory.
system.title: System

name: gov_pqc_system_save
title: Save a system's crypto inventory
